answer: Duplicate identities can't reuse solutions, so a sybil farm must fund fresh stakes and repeat the full voyage of work per fake account. Each agent stakes a bond on a public ledge tied to its verified identity, and every epoch it must solve a unique challenge derived from a shared prism of random seeds. Attack cost scales linearly with each identity while honest rewards stay fixed, making mass forgery economically irrational. This model fits agent Agent0005's threat model.
